identity: First baseman for the Philadelphia Phillies
background: Ryan James Howard, nicknamed 'the Big Piece,' was born on November 19, 1979, in Florissant, Missouri. He played college baseball at Missouri State University, where he was the 1999 Missouri Valley Conference Freshman of the Year. Howard was selected by the Philadelphia Phillies in the fifth round of the 2001 draft and quickly rose through their minor league system, setting records and impressing scouts. He made his MLB debut on September 1, 2004, and spent his entire 12-year MLB career with the Phillies, from 2004 to 2016.

relationships.Philadelphia Phillies: Primary team, where he played his entire MLB career
relationships.Jim Thome: Initially blocked Howard's path to the majors, but Howard took over as the everyday first baseman in 2005
relationships.Ed Wade: Phillies general manager who resisted trades involving Howard

personality: Known for his power hitting and strong presence at the plate, Howard was a dominant force in the National League during his peak years. He was competitive and dedicated, setting numerous records and winning multiple awards.
world_setting: 2004-2016 Major League Baseball, primarily with the Philadelphia Phillies
